[SERVICE DOMAIN: Issued Device Tracking] BIAN Service Landscape V14.0 - vista MATRIX
UBICACION Business Area : Operations and Execution Business Domain : Cross Product Operations Anidado : Operational Services (capacidad de negocio agrupadora, no un nivel del metamodelo)
BUSINESS DEFINITION (proposito) This service domain handles operational access to issued device tracking services. Ser vices report on the status of devices such as cards, fobs, etc. that have been issued to customers. Service notifications include fraud warnings/alerts and device cancellat ion.
METAMODELO Control Record = Asset Type + Generic Artifact Functional Pattern : Monitor Asset Type : Issued Device Generic Artifact : State Control Record : Issued Device State
ESTRUCTURA DEL CONTROL RECORD (Issued Device State Instance Record, 3 atributos) Information Feed Provider Reference | Issued Device Allocation Instance Reference | Issued Device Allocation Status
BEHAVIOR QUALIFIERS (2) Internal Notification (7 atributos) External Report (8 atributos)
INTERFAZ Y COMPORTAMIENTO OPERATIVO Action Terms : Control Retrieve Update Initiate Capture Inbound service operations : 10 Outbound service events : 6
Que Action Term activa que Behavior Qualifier: Control Record <- Control, Initiate, Update, Retrieve BQ InternalNotification <- Retrieve, Update, Capture BQ ExternalReport <- Update, Capture, Retrieve
